shared_elements: human figure in strict profile, bearded, in low relief
long patterned/fringed robe with rendered textile detail
figure holding an object in a raised hand
rosette/floral motifs used as decorative filler or border
justification: Both depict bearded male figures in shallow relief, strictly in profile, wearing long fringed and finely patterned garments and carrying objects in the hand, with rosette-like floral motifs used decoratively and horizontal register/band divisions. The biggest difference in content is that B is a single monumental hybrid being with raptor head and multiple wings isolated in a floral field, whereas A shows repeated ranks of ordinary human attendants with led animals and a tree in continuous processional friezes.
